# Tailor CV & Cover Letter

Tailor `cv/master.md` and `cv/cover-letter.md` for the job below.

## Job Details

Job title: {{jobTitle}}
Company: {{company}}
Job description (paste or summarize):
{{jobDescription}}

## Instructions

1. Read `cv/master.md` to understand the base CV content.
2. Identify the **top 3–5 matching skills/experiences** from the CV that directly address this role.
3. Reorder bullet points in the Experience section to lead with those matches.
4. Write a **tailored cover letter** (3–4 paragraphs, ≤350 words):
   - Para 1: Why this role / company is compelling
   - Para 2: Most relevant technical experience (match to JD keywords)
   - Para 3: Leadership / mentoring highlight (if role requires it)
   - Para 4: Call to action
5. Save CV to `cv/tailored/{{company}}-{{jobTitle}}.md`
6. Save cover letter to `cv/tailored/{{company}}-{{jobTitle}}-cover.md`
7. Do NOT change contact details or Education section.
